title: Add option to change wallpaper for lock screen, login screen, and desktop all at once
line: System Settings > Wallpaper has a new "Set for lock screen" switch that applies the chosen wallpaper to the lock screen too.
explanation: The Wallpaper page in System Settings could already set a wallpaper on all screens at once ("Set for all screens"), but the lock screen wallpaper lived only in the Screen Locking page, so keeping them the same meant choosing it twice. The only shortcut was the file manager's "Set as Wallpaper > Both" entry, which only works for single image files. The change adds a "Set for lock screen" switch next to "Set for all screens": on Apply it writes the same wallpaper plugin and its settings to kscreenlockerrc (only real config items, and values equal to the default are left out so the lock screen keeps its own defaults such as forced animation).

commits.message:
kcms/wallpaper: add an option to also set the wallpaper for the lock screen

Using the same wallpaper on the desktop and on the lock screen meant
setting it twice in two different pages. Add a "Set for lock screen"
switch next to "Set for all screens" that also applies it there.

BUG: 367666

media.caption: Master: the Wallpaper page only changes the desktop (Altai chosen, Apply pressed).
Master: the lock screen afterwards still shows the old wallpaper.
With the fix: a "Set for lock screen" switch in the page header, turned on, Altai chosen.
After Apply, the lock screen shows Altai too.
